summary: ACDE #228：EIP-7954 合约大小上限提到 32KiB 列为 CFI；EIP-8037 状态创建 gas 上调待下次 ACDT 决定；EIP-7793 条件交易、EIP-5920 PAY 操作码、EIP-8051 ML-DSA 预编译等七项被拒。Sednaoui 提出用 MPT 证明与多节点共识验证交易模拟，避免钱包盲信 RPC。etan-status 的批量优先费与 EIP-7799 手续费日志合并。

items.title: ethresear.ch：用状态证明做信任最小化的交易模拟
items.note: （Sednaoui）14:54：交易模拟对钱包安全至关重要，但目前要盲信 RPC 提供的状态；文章用 MPT 证明与多节点共识在密码学上验证模拟所用状态。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Trust minimized transaction simulation using state proofs
items.note_en: (Sednaoui), 14:54: simulation is critical to wallet safety but today relies on blindly trusting RPC state, so the post uses MPT proofs and multi node consensus to verify the state behind simulations.

keywords_en: ACDE #228 lists EIP-7954 as CFI and declines seven EIPs
EIP-8037 left to the next ACDT
trust minimized transaction simulation with state proofs
a batch priority fees EIP merged
a transaction gas limit cap RPC method merged
summary_en: ACDE #228: EIP-7954, raising the contract size limit to 32KiB, is CFI; the EIP-8037 state creation gas increase goes to the next ACDT; seven EIPs including EIP-7793 conditional transactions, EIP-5920 PAY and the EIP-8051 ML-DSA precompile were declined. Sednaoui proposed verifying transaction simulation with MPT proofs and multi node consensus so wallets need not blindly trust RPCs. etan-status's batch priority fees and EIP-7799 fee payment log merged.
